_comment: Drop this into Cline's MCP config (~/.cline/mcp_config.json or via Cline UI > MCP Servers > Add Server). AstroQuest City MCP server must be running on port 6789.

_provider_config._comment: Cline's API provider config (set in Cline UI > API Provider). This shows the OpenAI-compatible endpoint you'd point Cline at to use your AQ providers instead of OpenAI/Anthropic directly.
_provider_config._comment_2: Cline passes 'model': 'auto' on every call. Our Smart Tier Auto-Router picks the right tier based on the prompt content + length.
